summary: On paper Detroit has the edge (Detroit ranks 13th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.10), while the Jets's best counter is to stay sound vs motion (The Jets' defense ranks 1st in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.05 allowed). The model favors Detroit at 56%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and starting QB (0.8 pts).

NYJ.detail: The Jets' defense ranks 1st in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.05 allowed). Detroit ranks 13th (+0.10).

DET.detail: Detroit ranks 13th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.10). The Jets' defense ranks 1st (+0.05 allowed).

model.summary: Model: Detroit 56% to win, fair line DET -2. Market: Detroit 73%. The largest factor is home field, worth 1.7 points toward Detroit.

model_cards.t1: The model likes the Jets more than the market.
model_cards.sub: Win probability. Market = vig-free moneyline at build time.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Not betting advice · market line at build time

model_cards.sub: Each factor's push on the projected margin, in points. Positive = toward Detroit. Sum = DET -2.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Linear model, so contributions are exact SHAP values · vs. an average matchup

model_cards.sub: Distribution of Detroit's margin. Shaded area = Detroit win (56%).
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Normal margin, sigma = 12.0 points (fit by log loss)
